# The chain net as three bands for the game (bones net0..net2): band k is built with its top centre
# (its hinge) at the origin, so the game hangs each from the one above. Generated by make_hoop.py.
new
material new Net --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Net0 --vertices 12 --radius1 0.2917 --radius2 0.3300 --depth 0.1617 --cap-fill none --location 0 0 -0.0808
apply --location
active Net0
mode edit
select all
uv cylinder-project
mode object
material assign Net
add mesh cone --name Net1 --vertices 12 --radius1 0.2533 --radius2 0.2917 --depth 0.1617 --cap-fill none --location 0 0 -0.0808
apply --location
active Net1
mode edit
select all
uv cylinder-project
mode object
material assign Net
add mesh cone --name Net2 --vertices 12 --radius1 0.2150 --radius2 0.2533 --depth 0.1617 --cap-fill none --location 0 0 -0.0808
apply --location
active Net2
mode edit
select all
uv cylinder-project
mode object
material assign Net
material texture Net base-color textures/net.png
select all
shade flat
select Net0
export net0.glb --selection
select Net1
export net1.glb --selection
select Net2
export net2.glb --selection
